question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.**

Majority of the people / do not comprehend / the vissicitudes / of regular life.
solution: The correct answer is: **the vissicitudes** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The segment that contains a spelling error is: "**vissicitudes**" • The correct spelling of the word is "**vicissitudes (**उलटफेर**)**." • "**Vicissitudes**" refers to the unpredictable changes, fluctuations, or variations that occur as part of the natural course of events in life. (उलटफेर) • **Example**: *Despite facing many vicissitudes throughout his career, he remained resilient and adaptable, always finding a way to overcome challenges and emerge stronger.* Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**. 36:Te9d,
